hackathon_details_team_hint: From 1 to {max} people. With a smallest team of 1, people can also take part alone.
hackathon_details_rules_ph: What teams may build, what they must hand in, and how they behave.
hackathon_details_ai_disclosed_hint: Teams may use AI tools and name them with their submission.
hackathon_details_ai_native_hint: Built around AI coding tools: every submission names the ones it used.
hackathon_details_ai_restricted_hint: AI tools are limited as your note explains. Teams still say what they used.
hackathon_details_licence_ph: Who owns what teams build, and under which licence it is shared.
hackathon_details_error_registration_clo: Registration closes after it opens, and no later than kickoff.
hackathon_details_error_submission_deadl: Submissions close after kickoff, and no later than the end of demo day.
hackathon_details_error_team_min: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
hackathon_details_error_team_max: Enter a whole number no smaller than the smallest team, up to {max}.
hackathon_details_error_whole_number: Enter a whole number up to {max}, or leave it empty.
hackathon_details_error_rate_limited: You have saved several changes recently. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
hackathon_details_error_save: Couldn’t save the details. Try again.
hackathon_details_locked_notice: Registration is open, so the rules people signed up under stay as they are. Places can grow, and dates still ahead can only move later.
hackathon_details_error_conflict: This hackathon changed since you opened it. Reload the page to see the latest, then save again.
hackathon_details_error_locked: Registration is open, so places can only grow and dates can only move later.
hackathon_tracks_hint: What teams build toward. Add up to {max}, in the order participants will see them.
hackathon_tracks_needs_details: Save the rules and who can take part first, then add tracks.
hackathon_tracks_locked_hint: Registration is open, so saved tracks can be reworded but not removed.
hackathon_track_brief_ph: The problem or the goal, and what a good submission looks like.
hackathon_track_sources_hint: GitHub repositories or issues, or djazair.dev Hub links.
hackathon_track_error_title: Give the track a title of 3 to 100 characters.
hackathon_track_error_brief: Describe the track in 20 to 2,000 characters.
hackathon_track_error_partner: Name the partner in 2 to 100 characters.
hackathon_track_error_source: Use a GitHub repository or issue, or a djazair.dev Hub link.
hackathon_track_error_sources: Add at least one link, each once.
hackathon_tracks_error_has_prizes: A prize names a track you removed. Change or remove that prize first.
hackathon_prizes_hint: Prizes for the whole hackathon or for one track. A prize stays off the hackathon’s page until you record its provider’s confirmation.
hackathon_prizes_needs_details: Save the rules and who can take part first, then add prizes.
hackathon_prizes_locked_hint: Registration is open: you can still add prizes and record confirmations, but saved prizes stay as they are.
hackathon_prizes_empty: No prizes yet. Prizes are optional.
hackathon_prize_confirmed_on: Confirmed on {date}. Only organisers see this note:
hackathon_prize_value_hint: Leave it empty for a prize with no cash value.
hackathon_prize_recorded: Confirmation recorded. The prize can now show on the hackathon’s page.
hackathon_prize_clears_confirmation: A new prize, value or provider takes the confirmation away until the provider confirms again.
hackathon_prize_note_hint: Who confirmed, when and how. Only organisers see it.
hackathon_prize_error_title: Name the prize in 3 to 100 characters.
hackathon_prize_error_provider: Name who provides it in 2 to 100 characters.
hackathon_prize_error_value: Enter an amount such as 50000 or 1500.50.
hackathon_prize_error_note: Write at least {min} characters on how it was confirmed.
hackathon_prize_error_gone: This prize changed or was withdrawn. The list is up to date now.
hackathon_phase_registration_closed: Registration has closed. The hackathon kicks off {date}.
hackathon_phase_judging: Submissions are closed and the jury is judging until {date}.
hackathon_dashboard_error: The overview could not be loaded.
hackathon_edit_error_details_required: Save the rules and who can take part first.
hackathon_rubric_hint: Three or four criteria judges score each submission on. Their weights add up to 100.
hackathon_rubric_needs_details: Save the rules and who can take part first, then set the rubric.
hackathon_rubric_locked: Registration is open, so the rubric stays as it is.
hackathon_criterion_error_name: Name the criterion in 3 to 60 characters.
hackathon_criterion_error_weight: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
hackathon_rubric_error_total: The weights add up to {total}. Make them add up to 100.
hackathon_rubric_error_names: Give each criterion a different name.

hackathon_review_hint: The Founders Coffee team reads every hackathon before it is published. It needs:
hackathon_review_need_details: Its rules and who can take part
hackathon_review_need_rubric: A rubric whose weights add up to 100
hackathon_review_unready: Finish what is missing above, then send it.
hackathon_review_submitted: Sent for review. The Founders Coffee team will email you when they decide; until then, the hackathon cannot change.
hackathon_review_rejected: The reviewers sent it back. Change it as their note says, then send it again.
hackathon_review_error_incomplete: Something is still missing. Check the list above.
hackathon_review_error_not_submittable: This hackathon is already with the reviewers or published.
email_hackathon_decision_approved: {title} is approved and published. Members can see it now, and register once registration opens.
email_hackathon_decision_rejected: We could not publish {title} yet. Change it as the note below says, then send it for review again from its page.
admin_hkn_empty: No hackathons are waiting for review.
admin_hkn_unavailable: The hackathons could not be loaded.
admin_hkn_rubric_scale: Each criterion is scored from 1 to {max}
admin_hkn_note_hint: Sent in the email. Needed to reject.
admin_hkn_note_needed: Write a note of at least {min} characters to reject.
admin_hkn_decided: Decision saved. The organisers are told by email.
admin_hkn_stale: This hackathon changed since the list loaded. The list is up to date now.
admin_hkn_decision_failed: The decision could not be saved.
